info.prompt: A dystopian casino confessional booth where the player kneels before a gilded cyber-monk hologram, its skeletal faceplate flickering between neon cyan and electric magenta as it judges their dice rolls against a backdrop of pulsating neural latticework—every surface polished obsidian black except for the glowing amber terminal text at their feet, which scrolls real-time probability calculations in a dead liturgical chant, merging prayer and code into a single bio-mechanical sacrament.
